_comment: All seven wear the SAME family, because ASSET_INVENTORY section 5
says 'the seven look the same everywhere or they teach nothing'. The
silhouette sheet is therefore the important one: if they do not read
as seven different promises without hue, the family is too uniform.
wind_ring is `centre` anchored and wind_perch is `ceiling` anchored,
so both carry a y in their offset. Placing either at floor level is
